wages.text: Aguilar co-sponsored federal legislation to raise the minimum wage.
wages.quote: Rep. Pete Aguilar announced his co-sponsorship of a bill to raise the federal minimum wage

trade.text: Aguilar repeatedly criticized broad tariffs for raising prices and hurting businesses.
trade.quote: Trump's reckless tariffs are hurting local businesses and driving up costs for Inland Empire families

debt.text: Aguilar says the commitment to seniors through Social Security and Medicare should be preserved without cuts.
debt.quote: The commitment we make to our seniors through Social Security and Medicare should be ironclad.

housing.text: Aguilar secured funding for projects to construct and expand affordable, workforce and student housing.
housing.quote: $1,000,000 for the Housing Authority of the County of San Bernardino’s Arrowhead Grove 132 Units of Affordable Housing Redevelopment Project to renovate and construct more than 130 new affordable and workforce rental housing units

schools.text: Introduced legislation to expand no-cost meal programs for students in public schools.
schools.quote: Introduced the No Hungry Kids in Schools Act to expand access to meals for every student in America by allowing states to provide no-cost meal programs in public schools.

immigration.text: Advanced legislation to allow DACA recipients to work in Congress and the federal government and to access federally backed mortgages.
immigration.quote: Passed legislation in the Appropriations Committee that would allow recipients of the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) Program, also known as Dreamers, to work in the United States Congress.

abortion.text: Aguilar helped pass legislation protecting abortion access, including travel across state lines.
abortion.quote: Rep. Aguilar helped pass the Ensuring Women's Right to Freedom Act (H.R. 8297), which will protect Americans from extreme state laws that criminalize abortion

cannabis.text: Aguilar voted to pass the MORE Act to federally decriminalize marijuana.
cannabis.quote: Federally decriminalizing cannabis is good for the economy, good for small business growth and good for our communities.

health.text: Aguilar backed letting Medicare negotiate drug prices and capping beneficiaries' out-of-pocket costs.
health.quote: This historic legislation allows Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices and caps out-of-pocket costs for Medicare beneficiaries at $2,000.

energy.text: Secured federal funding for an electric bus and charging infrastructure project to reduce air pollution and support a zero-emission transit fleet.
energy.quote: I’m proud to deliver $1 million for Omnitrans and the Inland Empire’s air quality by expanding and ensuring the long-term success of their electric bus fleet and charging infrastructure.

voting.text: Said he would fight efforts to undermine voting rights and argued that democracy is strongest when every voice is heard.
voting.quote: Because in America, our democracy is strongest when every voice is heard and when our government reflects the people it serves.

tax.text: Vargas favors a flat income tax with a tax-free floor and no new taxpayer-funded programs.
tax.quote: true fairness is achieved not by targeting success with higher rates, but by establishing a tax-free income floor that protects every family's basic needs, followed by a single, uniform flat rate that treats every citizen with the exact same standard of equality

debt.text: Vargas strongly agrees that the government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt.

housing.text: Vargas proposes using federal surplus land and incentives to build affordable homes and new neighborhoods.
housing.quote: I will fight to use empty federal land to build new neighborhoods.

schools.text: Vargas backs school choice and returning education decisions to families and local communities, away from federal control.
schools.quote: education decisions should be returned to families and local communities. The state-run system has ignored parents for too long, and federal mandates only make it worse

safety.text: Vargas emphasizes supporting law enforcement and removing dangerous criminals from communities.
safety.quote: Supporting Law Enforcement & Fire Service personnel in their mission to protect life and property

immigration.text: Vargas supports a legal, merit-based immigration system with strict vetting and opposes sanctuary cities.
immigration.quote: Immigration should be legal, orderly, and based on what strengthens our nation. I believe we should welcome those who follow the law, pass strict security vetting, and bring skills that contribute to our economy

guns.text: Vargas views gun ownership as a constitutional right, favoring restrictions only for serious felons or the mentally unstable.
guns.quote: Gun ownership is a constitutional right that should not be infringed. I believe the only appropriate restrictions are for individuals who have committed serious felonies or who are mentally unstable

abortion.text: Vargas opposes abortion in all cases, saying medical intervention should aim to save the baby.
abortion.quote: Never. Even if the mother's life is in danger, the baby should be delivered, and medical intervention should be extended to the baby with the intent to save his or her life if humanly possible

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Vargas opposes gender transition for minors and supports biological-sex-based spaces.
gender.quote: Attempts to physically or socially transition a child to the opposite sex constitute child abuse

health.text: Vargas opposes expanding public coverage beyond existing Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary

energy.text: Vargas says she would oppose bans on American energy production and expand domestic oil and gas production to lower costs.
energy.quote: I will vote to stop bans on American energy. By producing more oil and gas here at home, we lower the cost to fill your tank and heat your home.

voting.text: Vargas supports requiring photo identification for voters as an election-security measure.
voting.quote: There is absolutely no reason voters should not be required to prove their identity. Failing to enforce this basic security measure is irresponsible and leaves our country vulnerable
